title: Fractured Origin
description: Its Me, Myself, and I all into one origin
body:
These beings have been shattered upon the anvil of reality, capable of inhibiting multiple bodies sharing one mind and soul.
- 🟢 Endless Horde: Every 30 seconds you split off a fragment of yourself that fights for you for 60 seconds, (Secondary to toggle)
- 🟢 Mitosis: Holding a nether star allows you to create a greater fragment, fragments created this way can not die. sneaking looking at a greater fragment allows you to destroy it and return the nether star.
- 🔴 What are shields?: No shields.
- 🔴 Stomach Holes: Your Fragmented body cant process meat.
- 🔴 Brittle: You are very fragile.
- 🔴 Weak Arms: You are completly incapable of landing critical hits.

*Requires Provi's Origins
This origin would not be posible without the work of Provismet on Provi's Origins check it out:
[https://modrinth.com/mod/provis-origins](https://modrinth.com/mod/provis-origins)
